name: notebooks
description: Jupyter-style notebooks: cell-based documents saved on your drives, indexed and searchable, with version history and full AI tooling.
help: Notebooks are documents made of cells — markdown, rich text or checklists — that live on your drives like files: they are indexed, searchable and keep a full version history with diff and restore.
Rich text cells can embed images and reference files from your drives; markdown cells support the same file references. Drag a cell onto the AI chat to attach it as context.
When the module is first enabled a 'My Notebooks' drive is created, but you can create notebooks in any drive that is not read-only.
The lock icon blocks the AI from editing a notebook (the assistant warns you and asks to unlock first); the eye-slash icon hides the notebook from the AI entirely. Read mode can print the page.
